query:
select w.id as "id!"
           from unnest($1::bigint[]) as w(id)
           left join structures s on s.id = w.id
           where s.id is null
              or s.updated_at < now() - case when s.name is null
                                             then interval '1 day'
                                             else interval '7 days' end
           order by s.id is not null, s.updated_at
           limit $2
